stages.name: The Oni's Shadow
stages.description: "You're not Madame Oni anymore... you're just an Oni, a Vicious Oni."

stages.name: Rolling Fate
stages.description: Every ring is a press of Delete Key in the mortal realm. You do not understand its langquge, but you always find out the next day that a fork in life that should have led to you has been quietly wiped away. < Fate Striker > Continously summons "Certain Fates" when activated

stages.name: The Yakuza Way
stages.description: The cleanup is done. Load the remains into the trunk, get in the driver's seat, and leave. Nothing in the rearview mirror. You are not being followed. Why, then, do you hear the sound of breathing from behind you? < Fate Striker > Continuously summons "Certain Fates" when activated

stages.name: Tales of the Supernatural
stages.description: It is an ordinary evening. The video editor is doing overtime as usual. He spots a black shadow in the footage. As he plays it frame by frame, the black shadow slowly approaches with a smile on its face. < Fate Striker > Continuously summons "Certain Fates" when activated

stages.name: Notice: Nighttime Runaway
stages.description: Rubble starts to move itself in a noisy street, revealing a black hole on the sidewalk, waiting for the fugitive to leap in. < Fate Striker > Continuously summons "Certain Fates" when activated

stages.name: Hyakumonogatari
stages.description: Every page of the old diary records the name of a participant. When the last story is told, the last page is turned, and the last candle is blown out— < Fate Striker > Continuously summons "Certain Fates" when activated

stages.name: Snowflake Screen
stages.description: Snowflake-like dots roil, like a trapped memory knocking on the screen from inside, looking for a way out. The agitation ceases, and a cold face emerges from the crack. < Fate Striker > Continuously summons "Certain Fates" when activated < Stress-Relief Helper > Reflects "Certain Fates", activated after some time

stages.name: Legacy of Ruin
stages.description: The seed has been planted. All that follows is in the name of a greater, more beautiful sacrifice. < Fate Striker > Continuously summons "Certain Fates" when activated < Stress-Relief Helper > Reflects "Certain Fates", activated after some time

stages.name: Maelstrom
stages.description: Dragged in, swallowed, no way out, no escape, nowhere to run... why run? < Fate Striker > Continuously summons "Certain Fates" when activated < Stress-Relief Helper > Reflects "Certain Fates", activated after some time

stages.name: Starting Point
stages.description: You swear you heard the spring say "goodbye" when you released the switch. Push enemies into the pit to earn points! Your units have greatly reduced Redeployment Time

stages.name: Bounceback
stages.description: You thought you had the perfect angle, but fate had different ideas. The sound of the back of the empty chair being hit is the rhythm of a heartbeat. Push enemies into the pit to earn points! Your units have greatly reduced Redeployment Time

stages.name: Full Circle
stages.description: You pray that everything will descend like fate. The scoring lights go out at the same time, and only the one with your name on it flashes in the darkness. Push enemies into the pit to earn points! Your units have greatly reduced Redeployment Time

stages.name: Cold Moonlight
stages.description: Perhaps it is best to be cold and heartless through and through. Perhaps that "home" should never have existed in the first place. < Fate Striker > Continuously summons "Certain Fates" when activated

stages.name: Flowing River
stages.description: The water will wash everything away, but the ways things were before will live on in memory. < Fate Striker > Continuously summons "Certain Fates" when activated < Stress-Relief Helper > Reflects "Certain Fates", activated after some time

stages.name: Wayfarer
stages.description: She is a wayfarer at home. She has found her home as a wayfarer.

stages.name: Aoba Billiards Hall
stages.description: A billiards hall in the old district. The green felt table looks brown in the dim light. If you hear the sound of balls hitting each other at midnight, it is an old friend putting in one last shot for you. < Fate Striker > Continuously summons "Certain Fates" when activated

stages.name: Shippuu Skating Rink
stages.description: A skating rink in the old district. They say you can see the mirror image of the streets if you make it past the end, but those who turn back at the end never find the beginning again. < Fate Striker > Continuously summons "Certain Fates" when activated

stages.name: Namikiri Bathhouse
stages.description: A bathhouse in the old district. As you are about to leave, the hot water forms a hand that grabs your ankle, forcing you to dance with the shadow in the middle of the bath. < Fate Striker > Continuously summons "Certain Fates" when activated

stages.name: Nakikamezaka Bowling Alley
stages.description: A bowling alley in the old district. When the last pin falls, you find your feet nailed to the ground, and look up to see yourself preparing to deliver the ball towards yourself. < Fate Striker > Continuously summons "Certain Fates" when activated < Zero-Stress Helper > Reflects "Certain Fates", activated after some time

stages.name: Tankon Arcade
stages.description: An arcade in the old district. The machines continue to emit rhythms even when the power is cut off, as though someone is forever trapped in the virtual stages. < Fate Striker > Continuously summons "Certain Fates" when activated < Zero-Stress Helper > Reflects "Certain Fates", activated after some time

stages.name: Upon Your Era
stages.description: Everything in the old district carries an aura of age. The new age does not need it. < Fate Striker > Continuously summons "Certain Fates" when activated < Zero-Stress Helper > Reflects "Certain Fates", activated after some time

stages.name: Blooming Bubble
stages.description: What is old must go. Tomorrow must come. < Fate Striker > Continuously summons "Certain Fates" when activated

stages.name: Broken Dream
stages.description: It is only his own dream. < Fate Striker > Continuously summons "Certain Fates" when activated

stages.name: Omikuji
stages.description: The tidings of fate are determined. < Fate Striker > Continuously summons "Certain Fates" when activated

stages.name: Haraiame
stages.description: The rain cannot cleanse the dust that pervades the mind. < Fate Striker > Continuously summons "Certain Fates" when activated

stages.name: Ouma
stages.description: The fabric of the mortal realm is lifted when day meets night. < Fate Striker > Continuously summons "Certain Fates" when activated < Zero-Stress Helper > Reflects "Certain Fates", activated after some time

stages.name: Zaigou
stages.description: The candle may go out, but the flames of karma burn bright. < Fate Striker > Continuously summons "Certain Fates" when activated < Zero-Stress Helper > Reflects "Certain Fates", activated after some time
